grade_gate.note: registration text said xfv_grade_quantile but pinned expected n~=144; xfv_grade reproduces 144 exactly (quantile reading = 36, kept as the strict-quantile tag)

tags.C-RP: position in {RP, SIRP, MIRP, LIRP} (generic 'P' is NOT RP-designated)
tags.C-KBB: milb k_rel >= +0.05 AND bb_rel >= +0.01 (elite K, bad BB vs level norms, latest MiLB season)
tags.strict-quantile: also clears xfv_grade_quantile >= 45.0 (the literal registration reading)

controls.pool: kind=active same-side players with xfv_minus_consensus < +2.0 (non-promoted), never in either treated cohort
controls.match: consensus_fv +/-2.5, age_now +/-2.0y, level_rank +/-1; greedy nearest by normalized distance, without replacement (reuse only on exhaustion, counted)

h1.primary: scout re-evaluation ONLY: consensus FV >= freeze FV + 2.5, OR new-source FV pickup vs freeze n_sources, OR top-100 entry (any source; none pre-freeze)
h1.explicit_miss: dropped-from-all-lists: no snapshot from any source in the 210 days before the scoring date

h2.primary: MLB debut by maturity (debut supersedes h1)

kill_rule.test: bootstrap P(treated hit rate > control hit rate) >= 0.90
kill_rule.on_fail: promotion channel flagged for shrinkage (owner decision, registry records it)

spec.output_guarantee: zero change to any published number; artifact is listed in deploy/data_exclude.txt
